_comment: Scoped to what this repo can pass TODAY (2026-08-31). A gate that is red on day one for reasons unrelated to the change being gated gets bypassed, and then it protects nothing. Re-enable each check below as its debt is paid; see docs/PRIORITY-ROADMAP.md Tier 2.

_disabledChecks._why: next lint reports many pre-existing errors (mostly @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any). Enable once they are cleared or downgraded in .eslintrc.json.
_disabledChecks.label: Lint

_disabledChecks._why: ~469 pre-existing errors, ~400 from types/database.ts being out of sync with what Supabase generates (every insert/update resolves to never). Regenerate that file, then enable. Note next.config.ts sets ignoreBuildErrors, so Build passing says nothing about types.
_disabledChecks.label: Type check

_disabledChecks._why: No test framework is installed and there are no test files. Install vitest and write tests before enabling.
_disabledChecks.label: Unit & Integration

_disabledChecks._why: No E2E framework and no test:e2e script.
_disabledChecks.label: E2E
